name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of asthma.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma.

name: patient_percent_predicted_fev1_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent
meaning: Numeric percentage representing the patient's current forced expiratory volume in one second (percent predicted).
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured percent predicted FEV1 value if a measurement is available for the patient now.

name: patient_can_undergo_respiratory_flow_volume_loop_measurement_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient can currently carry out a respiratory flow volume loop measurement.
when_true: Set to true if the patient can currently carry out a respiratory flow volume loop measurement.
when_false: Set to false if the patient cannot currently carry out a respiratory flow volume loop measurement.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient can currently carry out a respiratory flow volume loop measurement.

name: patient_number_of_reproducible_flow_volume_loops_able_to_perform_now
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the number of reproducible flow volume loops the patient is currently able to perform.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many reproducible flow volume loops the patient is currently able to perform.
when_value: Set to the number of reproducible flow volume loops the patient is currently able to perform.

name: patient_forced_expired_volume_in_1_second_value_recorded_now_withunit_milligram_methacholine
meaning: Numeric value representing the provocative dose (in mg methacholine) required to cause a 20% fall in the patient's FEV1, measured now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value (in mg methacholine) if a provocative dose causing a 20% fall in FEV1 is recorded now.

name: patient_has_moderate_bronchial_hyperresponsiveness_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has moderate bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has moderate bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have moderate bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has moderate bronchial hyperresponsiveness.

name: patient_has_severe_bronchial_hyperresponsiveness_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.

name: patient_has_bronchial_hyperresponsiveness_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has moderate or severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has either moderate or severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has neither moderate nor severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has moderate or severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.

name: patient_bronchial_hyperresponsiveness_measured_by_pd20fev1_leq_0_3mg_methacholine_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the provocative dose causing a 20% fall in FEV1 is ≤ 0.3 mg methacholine, measured now.
when_true: Set to true if the provocative dose causing a 20% fall in FEV1 is less than or equal to 0.3 mg methacholine, measured now.
when_false: Set to false if the provocative dose causing a 20% fall in FEV1 is greater than 0.3 mg methacholine, measured now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_beta_adrenergic_receptor_agonist_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever been exposed to a beta adrenergic receptor agonist at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever been exposed to a beta adrenergic receptor agonist at any time in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never been exposed to a beta adrenergic receptor agonist at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever been exposed to a beta adrenergic receptor agonist.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_beta_adrenergic_receptor_agonist_inthehistory@@washout_period_of_1_week_long_acting
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has had a washout period of at least 1 week for long acting beta agonists prior to inclusion.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has had a washout period of at least 1 week for long acting beta agonists prior to inclusion.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not had a washout period of at least 1 week for long acting beta agonists prior to inclusion.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has had a washout period of at least 1 week for long acting beta agonists prior to inclusion.

name: leukotriene_antagonist_washout_period_value_in_weeks
meaning: Numeric value indicating the length of the patient's washout period from leukotriene antagonists, measured in weeks, prior to inclusion.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined when the patient last received leukotriene antagonists.
when_value: Set to the number of weeks since the patient last received leukotriene antagonists prior to inclusion.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_leukotriene_receptor_antagonist_inthepast4weeks
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient was exposed to leukotriene receptor antagonists in the past 4 weeks prior to inclusion.
when_true: Set to true if the patient was exposed to leukotriene receptor antagonists at any time in the past 4 weeks prior to inclusion.
when_false: Set to false if the patient was not exposed to leukotriene receptor antagonists at any time in the past 4 weeks prior to inclusion.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient was exposed to leukotriene receptor antagonists in the past 4 weeks.

name: patient_forced_expired_volume_in_1_second_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent_predicted
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's forced expiratory volume in one second (FEV1) percent predicted, measured now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured percent predicted value if a numeric measurement of the patient's forced expiratory volume in one second (FEV1) percent predicted is recorded now.

name: patient_respiratory_flow_volume_loop_measurement_value_recorded_now_withunit_count
meaning: Numeric count representing the number of respiratory flow volume loop measurements the patient can currently carry out.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured count if the number of respiratory flow volume loop measurements the patient can currently carry out is available.

name: patient_respiratory_flow_volume_loop_measurement_value_recorded_now_withunit_count@@reproducible
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the counted respiratory flow volume loop measurements are reproducible.
when_true: Set to true if the counted respiratory flow volume loop measurements are reproducible.
when_false: Set to false if the counted respiratory flow volume loop measurements are not reproducible.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the measurements are reproducible.

name: pd20_fev1_value_recorded_now_withunit_mg_methacholine
meaning: Numeric value of PD20 FEV1 in mg methacholine, recorded currently.
when_unknown: Set to null if the value is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value (in milligrams) of methacholine required to cause a 20 percent fall in FEV1, as measured currently.

name: patient_has_moderate_or_severe_bronchial_hyperresponsiveness_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has moderate or severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has either moderate or severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has neither moderate nor severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has moderate or severe bronchial hyperresponsiveness.

name: patient_has_bronchial_hyperresponsiveness_now@@defined_by_pd20_fev1_leq_0_3mg_methacholine
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has bronchial hyperresponsiveness as defined by PD20 FEV1 ≤ 0.3 mg methacholine.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has bronchial hyperresponsiveness as defined by PD20 FEV1 less than or equal to 0.3 mg methacholine.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have bronchial hyperresponsiveness as defined by PD20 FEV1 less than or equal to 0.3 mg methacholine.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has bronchial hyperresponsiveness as defined by PD20 FEV1 less than or equal to 0.3 mg methacholine.

name: ipratropium_bromide_washout_period_value_in_weeks
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the length of the washout period for ipratropium bromide, measured in weeks, for the patient.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many weeks have elapsed since the patient's last exposure to ipratropium bromide.
when_value: Set to the number of weeks that have elapsed since the patient's last exposure to ipratropium bromide.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_ipratropium_bromide_inthepast1weeks
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient was exposed to ipratropium bromide within the past 1 week.
when_true: Set to true if the patient was exposed to ipratropium bromide within the past 1 week.
when_false: Set to false if the patient was not exposed to ipratropium bromide within the past 1 week.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient was exposed to ipratropium bromide within the past 1 week.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_beta_adrenergic_receptor_agonist_now

when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently exposed to beta adrenergic receptor agonist (beta agonist).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently exposed to beta adrenergic receptor agonist (beta agonist).

name: patient_is_exposed_to_beta_adrenergic_receptor_agonist_now@@washout_period_long_acting_agent_greater_than_or_equal_1_week

when_false: Set to false if the patient has not had a washout period of long acting beta adrenergic receptor agonist greater than or equal to 1 week.

when_unknown: Set to null if the duration of the washout period for long acting beta agonist is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of weeks representing the duration of the washout period for long acting beta agonist prior to inclusion.
